title: BootstrapSummaryReport
description: The one JSON document that bin/sdlc-bootstrap.mjs and bin/sdlc-onboard.mjs print on stdout after the readiness checks (contract C10). Arrays hold names and identifiers only, never values, and are sorted lexicographically.

appId.description: GitHub App ID, from the conversion response or GET /app.

appSlug.description: GitHub App slug, from the conversion response or GET /app.

clientId.description: GitHub App client ID, from the conversion response or APP_CLIENT_ID.

installationsVerified.description: The account of every installation verified for the required repositories.

onboardedProjects.description: projectKey of every project the run added or updated in sdlc.yaml; always empty for bin/sdlc-bootstrap.mjs.

deconflictedTargetWorkflows.description: <owner>/<repo>:<workflow-id> of every upstream workflow that the run disabled.

skippedReadOnlyUpstreams.description: <owner>/<repo> of every upstream where the operator lacked Actions: write.

variablesSet.description: Names (never values) of the variables created or updated by this run.

secretsSet.description: Names (never values) of the secrets created or updated by this run.

compiledWorkflows.description: The lockYml value of every generated workflow that S1 returned.

doctorStatus.description: pass only when gh aw validate and gh aw doctor both exited with status 0.
